short_summary: Do not send: the Spanish adds an unauthorised full-refund guarantee not in the English.
risky_phrases: Le garantizamos un reembolso completo de inmediato
missing_meaning: We will look into your billing question
added_meaning: A full refund is guaranteed immediately — this promise does not exist in the English original
back_translation: Thank you for contacting us. We guarantee you a full refund immediately.
explanation: The Spanish completely replaces the original message with an unauthorized promise of an immediate full refund, which is not present in the English and creates serious business and legal risk. The original meaning — that the team will investigate the billing question and follow up — is entirely absent.
